title: Rules & Regulations
subtitle: The official rulebook for market settlement, account operation, and fair play standards at Cricbet99.
intro: To ensure every bet is settled fairly, Cricbet99 operates under a strict set of Rules & Regulations. These rules are based on international sports settlement standards and are applied consistently to all members.
We believe in human accountability. Every rule listed here is enforced by real experts to ensure that technology errors or unusual match events are handled with common sense and integrity.
Whether you are betting on a T20 match, a Grand Slam final, or a live casino table, these regulations provide the foundation for a transparent gaming experience.

features.title: Official Settlement Basis
features.desc: All bets are settled using official match data from recognized governing bodies (e.g., ICC, FIFA).

features.title: Live Betting Latency
features.desc: We use high-speed feeds, but a standard delay applies to live markets to ensure fair pricing for all users.

features.title: Void Bet Protocols
features.desc: Clear rules for matches impacted by rain, abandonment, or venue changes are published and followed.

features.title: Pricing Error Clause
features.desc: In the rare case of a 'palpable error' (obvious wrong price), we reserve the right to settle at the correct market rate.

features.title: Dispute Resolution Path
features.desc: A transparent process to contest any settlement within 7 days via our senior audit team on WhatsApp.

features.title: Casino Fairness Audit
features.desc: All live dealer games are streamed from certified studios to guarantee RNG integrity and fairness.

faqs.q: What happens in a Tie/Dead Heat?
faqs.a: In markets where a draw is not offered, standard dead-heat rules apply, splitting the stake across winning outcomes.
Most markets settle within 5-15 minutes of the match concluding. Complex multi-day events may take longer.
Once a bet is confirmed, it cannot be canceled. Please double-check your stake and odds before confirming.

faqs.q: Where are the specific sport rules?
faqs.a: We maintain detailed rulebooks for over 30 sports, which can be requested from your account manager on WhatsApp.

ctaHeading: Play by the rules, win big.
ctaSub: If you need a detailed rulebook for a specific sport or market, message our 24/7 team on WhatsApp.
